integrity: All universal CDF, threshold, extremizer and onset assertions are supported by an explicit support-function proof. Numerical checks are corroborative and do not establish universally quantified claims.
scientific_limitations: The distribution applies only to convex hulls of two filled, coaxial, positive-radius disks at distinct heights in Euclidean three-space with Haar-uniform line directions. No noisy inverse result, planar projected-area claim, or noncoaxial generalization is asserted. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact directional-width law and three sharp transitions for circular frusta
